appraisal_events.evidence: On préférait à Bergotte, dont les plus jolies phrases avaient exigé en réalité un bien plus profond repli sur soi-même, des écrivains qui semblaient plus profonds simplement parce qu'ils écrivaient moins bien... des démocrates... faisaient ainsi aux gens du monde un honneur immérité.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator defends Bergotte's genuine subtlety and depth against a fashionable public that passed him over for writers who only seemed profound, framing that collective preference as a critical error.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator personally judges Bergotte's prose as requiring far deeper self-reflection than that of the writers currently in fashion.

The passage reports that the best part of contemporary youth publicly favored other, lesser writers over him, a collectively registered fall from critical favor even as the narrator disputes its fairness.
